$comment: The WhatsApp message templates Kicksmash sends outside a player's 24-hour window. Meta approves each one per language before it can be sent. src/lib/whatsapp/templates.ts builds the send from this file, scripts/whatsapp-templates.mjs creates the missing ones, and tests/whatsapp-notices.test.ts holds every body to Meta's rules. {base} is the deployment's address, filled in when the template is created; {{1}} in a URL is the part added when a message is sent (a match code, never a personal link).

en.body:
A spot is free in a padel match ({{1}}).

Playing so far: {{2}}. {{3}}.

Tap “I'm in” to take it, or open the match first.

ru.body:
